FADE IN:

EXT. OCEAN - DAY

We see a jellyfish, its translucent body glowing in the sunlight, floating effortlessly through the water. Suddenly, a human, JASON, appears out of nowhere, a fishing net in hand. He scoops up the jellyfish and pulls it out of the water.

JASON
(to himself)
Ah, a beauty. I've never seen one like this before.

The jellyfish, now out of its element, begins to struggle and pulse with agitation.

JASON
(laughing)
Don't worry, little guy. I won't hurt you.

Jason holds the jellyfish up to the sky, where a solar eclipse is about to occur. The jellyfish's eyes, once filled with a sense of wonder, now widen in terror.

JASON
(smiling)
Behold, the majesty of the universe.

The jellyfish's gaze is fixed on the eclipse, its body trembling with fear.

JASON
(leaning in)
You see, little one, the universe is full of mysteries beyond your comprehension.

The jellyfish's eyes begin to bulge as it stares at the eclipse.

JASON
(whispering)
Horrors beyond your comprehension, lurking in the shadows, waiting to consume you.

The jellyfish's body begins to contort and twist, its tentacles flailing wildly.

JASON
(laughing)
You can't even begin to imagine the horrors that lurk in the depths of space.

The jellyfish's monologue begins, its voice a mixture of terror and despair.

JELLYFISH
(whispering)
Oh, the abyssal voids that yawn open before me, like chasms of nothingness. The eldritch horrors that lurk in the darkness, waiting to consume me whole. The crushing weight of existence, bearing down upon me like a mountain range of despair.

JASON
(laughing)
You're just a jellyfish, little guy. You don't have to worry about such things.

The jellyfish's gaze never wavers from the eclipse.

JELLYFISH
(whispering)
But what if I do? What if I am but a mere speck in the grand tapestry of existence? What if my very existence is but a fleeting moment in the annals of time?

JASON
(shrugging)
You're just a jellyfish, remember?

The jellyfish's body begins to dissolve into a puddle of goo, its consciousness fragmenting into a thousand pieces.

JELLYFISH
(whispering)
No...no...this can't be...I am but a mere jellyfish...a mere speck in the grand tapestry of existence...

The jellyfish's monologue fades into the distance, its voice a mere whisper.

JASON
(laughing)
Well, I guess that's enough for today. Time to head back to shore.

As Jason walks away, the jellyfish's remains dissolve into the sand, its consciousness lost forever in the abyss of existence.

FADE TO BLACK.

This screenplay is a work of fiction and not meant to be taken seriously. The concept of a jellyfish experiencing a Lovecraftian monologue is purely imaginative and not based on any real-world scientific evidence.
